data.narrative:
Make Sunsets is a seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Luke Iseman and Andrew Song that has raised $800K to date. The valuation analysis draws on a reference universe of 9 peers in Climate & Energy (1 public, 8 private), including comparables such as Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Given the nascent stage and limited financial history, only one valuation method yielded sufficient analytical rigor. The Stage-Progression approach applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement to the $800K total raised as a proxy baseline, producing an implied value of $2.0M. A peer-median triangulation was not viable; while 8 same-sector peers exist, zero met the filters for same-stage or adjacent-stage comparability with sufficient datapoint density (minimum three required), and a broader cross-sector median would lack specificity for this stage and sector.

The triangulated valuation range is $1.7M to $2.3M, with a median of $2.0M. This analysis reflects material uncertainty around fair valuation at the seed stage, where revenue and proven unit economics remain absent. The range is sensitive to the multiplier assumption and the quality of future fundraising execution. Investors should treat this as a notional anchor pending either meaningful revenue traction or access to direct information on lead investor pricing in the next round.
